fixes.problem: Kitsunami card art is drawn lighter and more washed out than the real art. The heatmap shows a blue masked block, so the image seems offset or tinted differently. The real card has a purple Hidden Gems tint.
fixes.fix: Draw assets/s01.e30.art.png at exactly x=24, y=319.3, w=159.2, h=188.1 with object-fit:fill and no filter, opacity or overlay. Remove any extra background behind it.

fixes.problem: Parkour Reborn art is not at its rect: it is shifted and shows a gap on the right edge compared with the real card, which has the image running to the card edge under the purple tint.
fixes.fix: Draw assets/s01.e54.art.png at x=218.7, y=319.3, w=156.9, h=188.1, unscaled, with no border radius or padding. The real badge '26' sits on top of the art at the right edge, so keep it above.

fixes.problem: The bottom nav center icon is a cat-head outline. The real one is a filled purple/gray swirl logo. The search icon is thinner and the badge icons on the cards are different (the real ones are layered-square glyphs).
fixes.fix: Draw the center icon as a swirl (concentric spiral ring with two small ear tips) in #b8b0c8, about 28px, centered at x=205, y=805. Make the search icon stroke 2px. Use a stacked-squares glyph for the '31' and '26' badges.

fixes.problem: All text is red in the heatmap. The title 'Build, Share, Explore', the intro text and the card text sit about 1px too high and look slightly lighter or narrower. The card text wraps differently, e.g. the real '[Fragment Update!]' has a boxed emoji and 'could you... please...?' differs.
fixes.fix: Shift title, filters, intro, count row and card text down 1px (title y+1, '3,430 characters' y+1). Use Roboto with the same weights. Make the Parkour card lines wrap as in the real one: 'Because parkour reborn had a lore / I decided to make this bot.' and 'The lore of Parkour Reborn takes / place in the city of Verna. You are / one of the Runners'.

fixes.problem: The background is a flat navy with sharp dots. The real one is a soft starry nebula with a lighter blue-purple tone, and the card interior has a faint glow and a lighter border. The heatmap is red over the whole card.
fixes.fix: Use a softer background: base #141a45 with radial gradients of #2a2f6e at the top and #3a2d6b near the bottom, 1px star dots at 40% opacity (no large bright dots). Give the card a 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.18), a fill rgba(60,70,130,0.25), and radius 16px.

fixes.problem: The headline 'More memory for long chats.' and the '$12.99' price use a heavier, narrower serif than the real, thinner, wider one.
fixes.fix: Use a lighter-weight display serif (weight 400-500, e.g. 'DM Serif Display' at regular weight or Playfair 500). Headline 32px, line-height 36px, centered. Price 40px regular. Keep the lines at the same y as now, adjusting the width so '$12.99' spans x=47 to 155.

fixes.problem: Body texts are about 1px off: 'Payment will be charged...' wraps differently and the checklist rows are about 1px lower in the real one. The checkmark icons are bolder in the mock.
fixes.fix: Shift the checklist and the legal text down 1px. Wrap the legal text as: 'Payment will be charged to your Google Play account at confirmation of / purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled before the end of / the current period. You can manage or cancel in Google Play subscriptions after / purchase.' Use 1.5px stroke, #aab0c8 for the check icons.

fixes.problem: The Miro avatar is a blurry brown blob and the badge next to the name is a blue rectangle. The real avatar is a portrait with warm skin and dark hair, and the badge is a small eye icon.
fixes.fix: Draw the avatar as a 44x44 rounded square at x=4, y=125 with sharper detail: dark brown/green hair at the top, skin tone #c58a62 face, dark clothes. Replace the badge with a small blue eye glyph (#3b5bdb, 14x8 almond with a white dot).

fixes.problem: The message text wraps differently from the real one (e.g. 'His brain kept doing that thing it did every time / he got dropped somewhere new:'), and the text is a bit narrower, which causes all the red lines.
fixes.fix: Set the paragraph width to 320px with 18px Roboto and 24px line-height, and force breaks to match the real lines: '...even like / this. His back ached from the metal bars. His / brain kept doing that thing it did every time / he got dropped somewhere new: Count exits. / Count guards. Count how fast they can drop / you if you run.'

fixes.problem: The feed behind the drawer is wrong: the real one shows the 'Parkour' card at a shifted position (card edge x=87, badge '26' at x~70) and the sparkle at y~730. The mock has it shifted about 20px left, and the hamburger icon is brighter and larger.
fixes.fix: Shift the background feed 18px right so the '26' badge sits at x=60-97, and 'Female' at x=0-38 (bottom). Place the sparkle at x=45,y=732. Dim it with a rgba(0,0,0,0.5) overlay, and make the hamburger icon 16px wide in #8a8a90, at x=64-80,y=21-35.

fixes.problem: The drawer items are 1px higher than the real ones, the Media Library icon is different (a folder with an image in the real one), and the Upgrade banner has a plainer background than the real starry blue gradient.
fixes.fix: Move all menu rows down 1px. Replace the Media Library icon with a folder outline holding a small mountain. Give the Upgrade banner a gradient from #101a4a to #2b3a8a with a few 1px light dots, and extend it to x=411 with a 12px left radius only.

summary: Layout is nearly exact: all data-el boxes are in place and taps work, so the remaining gains come from visuals. This round should focus on the card art placement on s01, the soft nebula background and lighter serif type on s14, the real avatar and line wrapping on s25, and the dimmed feed behind the s06 drawer. Also fix the swirl nav icon and the 1px text offsets..
